desc: Read the input string $S$ from standard input.
Construct the auxiliary string $T = S + \text{'\#'} + S[::-1]$.
Implement the KMP prefix function (pi array) calculation for $T$.
Determine the length of the longest palindromic suffix of $S$ using the last value of the pi array.
Construct and print the result by concatenating $S$ with the necessary characters from the reversed string to complete the palindrome.
Run the code against Sample 1: Input "ABC", Expected Output "ABCBA".
Run the code against Sample 2: Input "Z", Expected Output "Z".
Run the code against Sample 3: Input "TREE", Expected Output "TREERT".
Run a stress test with a large random string to ensure no TLE.
